image_query: Padmapani Bodhisattva mural Ajanta Cave 1 painting
tweets: Padmapani, the lotus-bearing Bodhisattva of compassion, gazes down from the walls of Cave 1 at Ajanta — painted not in true fresco but tempera on dry lime plaster, pigments ground from ochre, lapis and soot. Vākāṭaka period, c. 475–500 CE.
